notes: Assassination at 60, hand-curated from simmed candidates (design/reviews/2026-10-07-rogue-curation.md). Mutilate builds, and combo points are spent from four: Eviscerate first (with Cold Blood ahead of it), then Slice and Dice and Venom as the cheaper finishers on the beats where there is not yet 35 energy for Eviscerate, each refreshed only when it has lapsed. Without the Mutilate or Venom talents the corresponding lines fall through to Sinister Strike and the other finishers. Every rank named here is checked against this build's own spellconst.

expected_idle.reason: Sinister Strike is the builder only for a rogue without Mutilate (its line is gated on Mutilate being unknown); from the rung where the talent is taken, Mutilate builds every combo point and Sinister Strike is idle by design.

engineering_notes.2: sim/rogue/venom.go: an untalented rogue has no Venom spell registered.
engineering_notes.5: sim/rogue/mutilate.go: an untalented rogue has no Mutilate spell registered.
engineering_notes.3: Previously starved entirely: Slice and Dice used to sit ahead of this line instead, re-applying itself at currentComboPoints >= 1 with no floor, so it looped at 1-3 combo points forever and this line never saw five combo points.

priorityList.notes: Cold Blood right before the finisher, for a guaranteed crit on the next Eviscerate. It costs no combo points and no global cooldown, so it is checked first and simply waits for the finisher below.

Eviscerate at four or more combo points, whenever its 35 energy is there. Mutilate gives two combo points a cast, so combo points arrive in steps of two; waiting for a fifth wastes one of them and a Mutilate on top.

Slice and Dice when Eviscerate is out of reach on energy: opened when it is down and refreshed under 3 seconds remaining. At 25 energy it is the cheaper finisher, so it picks up the combo points on the beats where there is not yet 35 energy for Eviscerate.
Venom, this tree's poison finisher, kept up the same way: cast when it has lapsed and Eviscerate is not affordable. It raises poison damage by 30% and poison proc chance by 10 points while it lasts.
Mutilate is this tree's builder: both weapons strike for 2 combo points a cast. Without the talent this falls through to Sinister Strike.
Sinister Strike builds only for a rogue without Mutilate; once the talent is taken Mutilate builds every combo point and this line is idle by design.
